reserveReview.rationale: Backed identifies bIB01 as a tracker certificate whose sole underlying is the iShares IB01 UCITS ETF. On July 21, 2026, Backed's public assetReserves feed reported 2,008 IB01 reserve shares against 1,967.285993046277 bIB01 in circulation, with Chainlink as provider. The reserve is recorded as one fund-share position; the proof does not justify decomposing the ETF's changing security-level holdings. September 15, 2026 review independently reproduced distributed circulation by subtracting the two issuer-documented working-capital and treasury inventories from same-block gross supply. All eight issuer-documented EVM deployments were checked, including zero-supply Fantom. Current raw amounts match the issuer API on every reported chain; omitted BSC and Fantom deployments independently have zero gross and circulating supply. This establishes a current distributed-certificate denominator without treating the undated API or gross premint inventory as current liabilities. The reserve oracle retains its own observation clock; no fund look-through or legal segregation is inferred.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Backed bIB01 product disclosure and Chainlink/The Network Firm reserve proof
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The certificate's underlying fund is fully identified; the ETF's changing security-level portfolio and Backed custodian allocations are outside this single-underlying composition.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Backed names three possible brokers and custodians plus the security agent but does not publish which provider holds the current bIB01 reserve or any provider shares. The reviewed product page and reserve-feed description do not establish current product-specific segregation, insolvency, or rehypothecation terms, so those safeguards remain unknown.
